comment: Source review 5a: two menu command options written as abbreviations parseoptions() accepts (menu_select_p for menu_select_page, menu_invert_a for menu_invert_all) reach shared_menu_optfn() (options.c 2054-2062), whose check_misc_menu_command() (695-707) needs the complete name and returns -1, so both fail silently with no configuration error; MENU_DESELECT_ALL:& in capitals is the complete name and is applied. The menu control key list shows the defaults for the first two and '&' for the third.
